description: SEC-006 (HIGH): Update CSP headers in the edge worker to allow required third-party resources. The current CSP blocks Turnstile, PostHog, Sentry, and Cloudflare Web Analytics scripts from loading, breaking bot protection and analytics in production.
steps: 1. In apps/edge/src/index.ts, find the addSecurityHeaders function which sets Content-Security-Policy.

2. Update the CSP header value to include: script-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://static.cloudflareinsights.com https://app.posthog.com https://*.sentry-cdn.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.syrabit.ai https://app.posthog.com https://*.sentry.io https://*.ingest.sentry.io https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com;
3. Keep existing style-src, img-src, font-src, frame-ancestors directives intact.
4. Ensure the CSP is properly formatted as a single string without line breaks.
acceptance_criteria: Edge worker TypeScript compiles without errors
CSP script-src includes challenges.cloudflare.com, static.cloudflareinsights.com, app.posthog.com
CSP frame-src includes challenges.cloudflare.com for Turnstile widget iframe
